judgment_refs.phrase: authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency
judgment_refs.note: Authorization and role need an original source; blueprint identity alone is insufficient.

judgment_refs.phrase: moving or preparing to move in any direction
judgment_refs.note: Join original motion and visibly indicated preparation; no speed cutoff defines preparation.

judgment_refs.phrase: making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480
judgment_refs.note: Original equipment and pixels require independent review.

judgment_refs.phrase: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
judgment_refs.note: Officer identity, direction content, recipient and time require original review.

judgment_refs.phrase: Approaches the driver’s vehicle, proceed as required pursuant to subsection 1
judgment_refs.note: The three supplied subsection 1 duties require original yield, right-edge position and stop-until-passed review; synthetic response paths are diagnostics.

judgment_refs.phrase: Stops, proceed as required pursuant to NRS 484B.607
judgment_refs.note: Record the stopped alternative; the exact 484B.607 duties are absent from the frozen corpus.

sweep_specs.rationale: Source qualification and visibility remain unresolved judgments; selected cases are exact categorical probes, not numeric legal cutoffs.
missing_inputs: Original agency/authorization, lamp equipment, driver-visible preparation, hand-signal, and officer-direction source review; no numeric training judgment ranges supplied for these phrases.

cases.rationale: Shared semantic reference for the selected comparisons; this is not an additional capture or delivery recording.
